summary: Five shows. Impeccable's creator demos it (the most useful for Charlie: already available here); free swaps for paid agent tools (FluidVoice, Basic Memory, Scrapling, Buzz); Andrew's ten GrokBot agents; and REA plus Ghidra for copying software. Classified from descriptions only: transcripts were blocked on 17 Oct.

tools.name: Impeccable
tools.what: Open-source design partner for Claude Code and Codex: critiques a site, explores visual directions, live visual editing and AI-pattern detection.
tools.check: Description and chapters only: transcript blocked on 17 Oct (youtube-transcript.ai now needs a key). Add quote and opinion once fetched.

our_view.for_what: Making the TRADEFLOW demo and OS pages look less generic
our_view.why: Already available here and named in current focus for the TRADEFLOW operating screens; this episode is a full walkthrough with its creator.

vs.gap: frontend-design gives a first draft; Impeccable critiques and edits live. Which one Charlie prefers on his own page is untested.

tools.what: AI agents that study an existing app and rebuild a copy you can customise.

vs.gap: Cost and how well copies work beyond the 2048 demo are unknown.
